_readme: TMP_009 iteration 11 — Pony Diffusion V6 XL probe. PO request before pivoting away from base-model probes. Pony V6 XL is the canonical anime/character SDXL fine-tune (`score_9 score_8_up` tag convention). Per BENCHMARK lesson #1 (character bases collapse, iter 3 + iter 9), high risk of same trap. Run cheap (~6 s/img) to confirm/refute. Iter 6 prompt verbatim WITHOUT pony-specific score tags so A/B isolates base behaviour. Zero LoRA. Same fixture. Negative extended with anti-anime/anti-cartoon terms as a defensive probe (we will see if they help or trigger negation-paradox).
